cfg.title: CFG Scale
cfg.description: CFG (Classifier-Free Guidance) is a technique that adjusts how closely generated outputs follow input prompts by balancing precision and creativity. This field is only applicable to Qwen/Qwen-Image models.For text generation scenarios, the CFG value must be greater than 1. The official configuration uses 50 steps with CFG 4.0. When CFG is set too small, it becomes nearly impossible to generate text.

    - "1140x1472" (3:4)
    - "1584x1056" (3:2)
    - "1056x1584" (2:3)

guidance_scale.title: Guidance Scale
guidance_scale.description: This value is used to control the degree of match between the generated image and the given prompt. The higher the value, the more the generated image will tend to strictly match the text prompt. The lower the value, the more creative and diverse the generated image will be, potentially containing more unexpected elements.
